thread:
incident-bot: PAGED: streaming-decode OOM spike on pool-rt-decode-us-east-1 — >50% request drops, auto-quarantine triggered. telemetry: gpu_decode_oom_rate up from 0.2% -> 12% in 3m. tagging: P1.

Emma (oncall): I'm on it. Confirming which model/route? any clear customer reports?

Raj K: root cause looks like a token spiral from a subset of requests hitting /v1/stream with max_tokens header set to 1e6. ingress doesn't clamp header. a few clients sent extremely long "stopless" prompts; KV growth + decoder streaming caused CUDA OOMs.

Sophie: copy. saw similar pattern on the streaming tail bucket. requests were pinned to high-seq worker slices, leading to KV cache blowout.

Mike: can we quickly enforce a cap at the edge? we have an Envoy header rewrite we can push as a hotpatch to clamp max_tokens to 2048.

Emma (oncall): yes please. Raj can you prepare the patch? I'll coordinate the rollout and customer comms.

Raj K: pushing quick patch to ingress rules now — will rewrite header `x-max-tokens` -> min(value,2048). patch command:
```bash
# apply envoy header rewrite via ssm remote config
./infractl config set envoy.ingress.header_rewrite.max_tokens 'min(%REQ(x-max-tokens)% , 2048)'
./infractl rollout envoy-ingress --hotpatch
```

Zoe: starting rollout to us-east canary (5% traffic). watching OOMs. metrics: streaming-ooms Canary -> down by 60% within first 60s.

incident-bot: Canary status: healthy. fallback enabled: redirect 5% -> model-small-quant while canary verifies.

Sophie: good. next we should cordon and restart the worst nodes to free CUDA memory and clear fragmentation. node list: decode-nodes-3,4,7 are highest OOMs.

Mike: on it. commands:
```bash
kubectl cordon decode-n3 && kubectl drain decode-n3 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data --force
kubectl delete pod -l pool=rt-decode-us-east-1 -n inference --field-selector spec.nodeName=decode-n3
```

Emma (oncall): will coordinate with SRE on rolling restarts. CS: Zoe, do we have customer-facing impact triage? which accounts saw drops?

Zoe: cs-bot pulled tickets: 3 enterprise customers reported incomplete streams, ~1.2k API errors total in last 20m. ticket ids: INC-8842, INC-8847, INC-8849. Notifying customers with preliminary note: "We are mitigating an infrastructure issue affecting streaming responses; we recommend clients set max_tokens <= 2048 until resolved."

cs-bot: Sent initial outbound to impacted accounts with workaround and ETA 30m. (template used).

Raj K: after ingress clamp and canary, global rollout initiated. also added request-level token budget guard in the runtime to fail-fast on >2048 to avoid KV allocation. small runtime patch applied to pool (hotpatch id: hp-2026-03-15-31).

Sophie: after restarts and rollout, OOM rate dropped to baseline ~0.4%. request drop rate back down to 1.1% from 52%.

Emma (oncall): timeline for postmortem and next steps:
- immediate: keep header clamp and runtime guard for 48h.
- short: implement permanent ingress header validation and quota enforcement.
- medium: add per-client streaming token budgeting and early rejection + better telemetry to catch token spirals sooner.

Mike: will open a CI PR for integration test that simulates large max_tokens and asserts clamp.

Zoe: CS will follow up with impacted customers with root cause once postmortem ready.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigated — system stable. Final metrics snapshot attached to incident. Closing pager in 15m unless regressions. :white_check_mark:

Emma (oncall): thank you team. I'll take owner for the postmortem. I'll note timeline & actions in incident board.

Raj K: logs snippet from worst pod before restart:
```
E 15:22:11 kernel: cudaErrorIllegalAddress at decode_stream.cc:432
E 15:22:11 runtime: kv_cache_alloc: requested 1.2GiB, available 32MiB -> OOM
I 15:22:11 telemetry: request_id=abcd-1234 client=acme-corp max_tokens=1000000 route=/v1/stream
```

Sophie: adding runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/streaming-oom (applied temporary notes).

Emma (oncall): will schedule 1:1 with infra and product teams to discuss permanent guardrails. closing thread after postmortem doc is linked.
